info.title: GitLab
info.description: Connect to GitLab (SaaS gitlab.com or a self-managed instance) to manage projects, issues, merge requests, pipelines, and comments.

get.description: Gets the profile of the authenticated user.
Lists projects that the authenticated user can access.

parameters.name: membership
parameters.description: Limit to projects the current user is a member of.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Return projects matching the search term.

post.description: Creates a new GitLab project.

get.description: Gets a single project by numeric ID or URL-encoded path (group/project).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Return issues in the given state.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search issues by title and description.

post.description: Creates a new issue in a project.

get.description: Gets a single project issue by its internal ID (IID).

post.description: Adds a note (comment) to a project issue.

get.description: Lists merge requests for a project.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Return merge requests in the given state.

post.description: Creates a merge request in a project.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Filter pipelines by branch or tag name.

post.description: Creates (triggers) a new pipeline for a given branch or tag.
Forks a project into the current user's namespace or a chosen namespace.

put.description: Updates an existing merge request (for example, retitle, retarget, close, or reopen).
Accepts and merges a merge request.

post.description: Creates a new branch in the repository.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch name or commit SHA to create the branch from.

post.description: Creates a commit with one or more file actions (create, update, delete, move).

get.description: Gets a file from the repository, including its Base64 content.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Name of a branch, tag, or commit. Use HEAD for the default branch.

get.description: Lists the webhooks configured on a project.

delete.description: Deletes a project webhook by its ID. Use this to clean up hooks manually if needed.

ProjectId.name: id
ProjectId.description: The project numeric ID or URL-encoded path (for example, my-group/my-project).

IssueIid.name: issue_iid
IssueIid.description: The internal ID (IID) of the issue within the project.

HookId.name: hook_id
HookId.description: The ID of the project webhook.

PerPage.name: per_page
PerPage.description: Number of items to return per page (max 100).

Page.name: page
Page.description: Page number of results to return.

MergeRequestIid.name: merge_request_iid
MergeRequestIid.description: The internal ID (IID) of the merge request within the project.

FilePath.name: file_path
FilePath.description: URL-encoded full path to the file, e.g. lib/class.rb.

iid.description: Internal issue ID within the project.

labels.description: Comma-separated list of label names (replaces existing).

iid.description: Internal merge request ID within the project.

remove_source_branch.description: Remove the source branch when merged.

iid.description: Internal pipeline ID within the project.

ref.description: Branch or tag the pipeline runs on.
The branch or tag to run the pipeline on.

url.description: Callback URL the hook posts to.

push_events.description: Whether the hook fires on push events.

tag_push_events.description: Whether the hook fires on tag push events.

issues_events.description: Whether the hook fires on issue events.

confidential_issues_events.description: Whether the hook fires on confidential issue events.

merge_requests_events.description: Whether the hook fires on merge request events.

note_events.description: Whether the hook fires on comment (note) events.

confidential_note_events.description: Whether the hook fires on internal (confidential) note events.

job_events.description: Whether the hook fires on job events.

pipeline_events.description: Whether the hook fires on pipeline events.

wiki_page_events.description: Whether the hook fires on wiki page events.

deployment_events.description: Whether the hook fires on deployment events.

releases_events.description: Whether the hook fires on release events.

milestone_events.description: Whether the hook fires on milestone events.

feature_flag_events.description: Whether the hook fires on feature flag events.

resource_access_token_events.description: Whether the hook fires on project access token expiry events.

project.description: The project the event belongs to.

object_attributes.description: The issue that triggered the event.

iid.description: Internal issue ID within the project.

action.description: The action that occurred (open, update, close, reopen).

EventProject.description: The project the event belongs to.

object_attributes.description: The merge request that triggered the event.
The comment (note) that triggered the event.
The pipeline that triggered the event.
The wiki page that triggered the event.
The milestone that triggered the event.
The feature flag that triggered the event.
The project access token that is expiring.

commit.description: Most recent commit on the branch.

path.description: Custom repository path for the project.

namespace_id.description: Namespace (group) ID for the new project; defaults to the current user.

initialize_with_readme.description: Create a README so the repository has a default branch.

namespace_id.description: ID of the namespace to fork into.

namespace_path.description: Path of the namespace to fork into.

labels.description: Comma-separated list of label names (replaces existing).

squash.description: Squash commits into a single commit on merge.

should_remove_source_branch.description: Remove the source branch after merging.

action.description: The action to perform on the file.

previous_path.description: Original path when moving a file.

content.description: File content, required for create and update.

encoding.description: Encoding of the content (text or base64).

branch.description: Name of the branch to commit into.

start_branch.description: Name of the branch to start the new branch from, when creating one.

actions.description: The file actions to include in the commit.

scopes.api: Full read/write access to the GitLab API.
